name: Graded Transpiration Channel 48x24 (wall boundary layer)
description: P12-MESH-002 wall-gradient validation case: 2D channel H=1, L=4 with uniform wall transpiration -- fluid injected through the bottom wall and sucked through the top wall at V=2 (inlet-type velocity patches, no-slip u=0), inlet U=1 on the left, zero-gradient outlet with p=0 on the right; rho=1, mu=0.1, wall Reynolds number V H/nu = 20. The fully developed flow is an exact Navier-Stokes solution (v = V, p = p(x)): u(y) = C [H (exp(l y) - 1)/(exp(l H) - 1) - y], l = V/nu, C = U / (1/l - H/(exp(l H) - 1) - H/2), dp/dx = rho C V -- a boundary layer of thickness nu/V = 0.05 H at the suction (top) wall. Mesh: structured_cartesian 48x24 with y-grading geometric ratio 1.2 clustered at both walls (mesh.json grading). The same case without the grading block is the equal-cell-count uniform reference. See tests/integration/case/test_graded_mesh_production_case.cpp and results/p12-mesh-002/summary.md.
